notes: Two ح-branches, each with its own names, so no shared tail. «غير، واحد، منهم المغيرة» is an unnamed group that names Mughira among them (rule 8). «وذكر، آخر» in branch 1 is a further transmitter the text does not name, kept as unnamed in its place.

In branch 2, Warrad is Mughira's scribe (described, not a link). Mu'awiya's letter is scene. «فكتب إليه المغيرة إني سمعته يقول» makes Mughira the one asked who answers, so he is the last link (rule 6).
The archive flagged this report as uncertain (three routes); the reading keeps two groups and marks the unnamed gaps.
